description.fun: Shuppet feeds on negative feelings like anger, jealousy and resentment, collecting them with the horn on its head, so some people are actually glad to have it around. Swarms gather at dusk under the eaves of houses full of bad feeling, which gave rise to the proverb 'Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.' Sleep near one and you may wake up in a better mood.
description.guide: A Ghost-type Pokémon resembling a cloth puppet or teru teru bōzu doll, which feeds on negative emotions and lives in towns and cities. It is active at night. It evolves into Banette at level 37.
description.tagline: A puppet ghost that feeds on grudges and bad moods

description.fun: Banette was a stuffed toy that someone threw away, brought to life by a powerful grudge, and it roams garbage dumps and dark alleys searching for the person who discarded it. Its zipped mouth keeps its cursed energy in, and it lays curses by sticking pins into its own body like a voodoo doll. It's said that if it's cared for enough, its grudge fades and it turns back into a toy.
description.guide: A Ghost-type Pokémon based on a haunted doll, kept alive by a grudge against whoever threw it away. It lives in garbage dumps and dark alleys. It evolves from Shuppet at level 37 and can Mega Evolve with the Banettite.
description.tagline: A discarded doll brought to life by a grudge

description.fun: Mega Evolution fills Banette with so much power and spite that it can't help cursing its own Trainer. New zippers appear across its face, hands and body, and opening them releases the dark energy it holds back. It can make up to three copies of itself to fool foes.
